offers_products.reason: Sells water analytics instruments, UV and chlorine disinfection equipment (Hach, Trojan, Ott) and product marking/coding equipment (Videojet, Esko software).

offers_services.reason: Also provides service contracts, calibration, installation and software-enabled services, but these are secondary to equipment and consumables.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Customers are water utilities, industrial plants, and food, beverage and pharma manufacturers, not households.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Sells to municipal water utilities, industrial facilities, and consumer goods and pharma manufacturers.

recurring_revenue.reason: Large share from consumables, reagents, inks, replacement parts, software subscriptions and service on an installed base.

cyclical_demand.reason: Water testing, treatment and product traceability are compliance-driven, essential and consumables-heavy, so they hold up in downturns.

big_ticket.reason: Mostly instruments, reagents, inks and parts at modest unit prices, bought repeatedly.

people_delivered.reason: Value comes from instruments, consumables, software and technology, not staff time.

large_customers.reason: Main customers are municipal utilities, government agencies and large industrial and consumer goods manufacturers.

asset_heavy.reason: Technology and instrument manufacturer with moderate capital needs; growth comes mainly through acquisitions and R&D.

notes: Based on my knowledge of Veralto's segments, Water Quality and Product Quality & Innovation. The website text names only some brands.
